# RoofCoat Leads

> RoofCoat Leads is a lead generation agency for roof coating and roof restoration contractors in the United States and Australia. It runs Facebook ad campaigns on each contractor's behalf, screens every inquiry through a qualification funnel, and delivers the leads to the contractor in real time by SMS and email. It is operated by EZ Digital Marketing LLC and has been running since February 2026.

Key facts:

- Who it serves: contractors who apply commercial and residential roof coatings (silicone, acrylic, metal roof restoration, TPO and other flat or low-slope systems). It does not work with general roofing or roof replacement contractors.
- What the contractor gets: custom Facebook ad campaigns for their service area, a pre-qualification funnel (property type, roof age, timeline, budget), real-time lead delivery by SMS and email, follow-up call and text scripts, a dedicated campaign manager and monthly reporting.
- Price: $1,500 per month management fee. Ad spend is separate and paid by the contractor directly to Facebook, usually around $50 per day. Australian clients pay A$1,500 per month plus ad spend.
- Optional add-ons: AI appointment setter (+$500 per month) that contacts leads and books them onto the contractor's calendar; live secretary calls (+$500 per month) where a trained team calls each lead within minutes.
- Terms: month to month, no long-term contract, cancel anytime.
- Lead ownership: each lead from a contractor's campaign goes only to that contractor and is never resold. Service areas are not locked, so more than one contractor in the same area can run a campaign.
- Speed: campaigns usually go live within 48 hours of the strategy call, and first leads typically arrive within 24 to 48 hours of launch.
- Typical results: individual leads usually cost $30 to $60 in ad spend. Documented client campaigns have produced roughly 20 to 50 commercial inquiries a month depending on market. Results vary by market, budget and the contractor's own follow-up, and are not guaranteed.
- Coverage: all 50 US states, Washington DC, Puerto Rico and every Australian state and territory. Each campaign is targeted to the contractor's own service area.
- Contact: +1 (617) 279-3357, marcfriedmancm@roofcoatleads.com. A free 30-minute strategy call can be booked at https://www.roofcoatleads.com/get-started
